name: Shikama (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shikama town emblem in white: a flower-like outline enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Shikama, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 March 1978.

features.role: Shikama town emblem — a flower-like outline enclosing a stylised character
